items.titleZh: 林德布拉德：赞德福特冲刺赛不会太精彩
items.summaryZh: 阿尔维德·林德布拉德表示，赞德福特冲刺赛缺乏超车并不意外，但他认为这场比赛对自己的练习很有价值。

items.originalTitle: 林德布拉德：赞德福特冲刺赛不会太精彩
items.summaryEn: Arvid Lindblad said he was not surprised the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race lacked action, but he found the session useful for practice.
detailZh: 阿尔维德·林德布拉德对荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛缺乏动作并不感到意外。
首圈之后，前半段车阵中仅发生了一次位置变化。林德布拉德整场比赛都跟在加布里埃尔·博托莱托身后。
“我想我们都知道，在赞德福特举行的冲刺赛可能不会是最精彩的比赛，”林德布拉德说。
本周末的冲刺赛是F1今年六场冲刺赛中的第五场。这是赞德福特首次举办冲刺赛，尽管该赛道没有在未来举办另一场大奖赛的合同。
尽管自己的比赛中缺乏动作，林德布拉德表示这场比赛对练习很有用。“这让我在一条对我来说全新的赛道上又跑了20、25圈，这对本周末剩余的时间将非常有用，”他说。
“我认为速度老实说比预期的要好。我们通常在正赛中的表现比排位赛更挣扎一些，考虑到我们在排位赛中已经不太好了，能够相当有竞争力，相当轻松地跟住前面的两个人，我认为还不错。
“所以让我们看看本周末剩余的时间，但我们知道我们可以向前迈进一步。我知道我还能做得更好。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘是另一位整场比赛都无法挑战前车的车手。“我只是有点被困在奥斯卡[皮亚斯特里]后面，”他说。“在这里，一旦你接近，轮胎就会过热，你就无法超车，所以你就只能被困住。”
detailEn: Arvid Lindblad was not surprised the Dutch Grand prix sprint race lacked action.
Only a single position change occured in the top half of the field after the first lap. Lindblad spent his entire race behind Gabriel Bortoleto.
“I think we all knew a sprint race at Zandvoort’s probably not going to be the most exciting race,” said Lindblad.

This weekend’s sprint race is the fifth of the six Formula 1 will hold this year. It is the first time Zandvoort has held a sprint race, though the track does not have a contract to hold another grand prix in the future.

Despite the lack of action in his race, Lindblad said the session was useful for practice. “It’s another 20, 25 laps under my belt on a new track for me which is going to very useful for the rest of the weekend,” he said.

“I think the pace is honestly better than expected. We normally struggle a little bit more in the race than quali and considering we already weren’t great in quali, to be quite competitive, quite easily able to hang on to the two guys in front I think was decent.
“So let’s see for the rest of the weekend, but we know we can make a step forward. I know there’s more to come from me.”

Max Verstappen was another driver who spent his enter race unable to challenge the driver ahead of him. “I just got a bit stuck behind Oscar [Piastri],” he said. “Around here, as soon as you get close your tyres overheat and you can’t pass, so you’re just stuck.”
keyPointsZh: 冲刺赛首圈后，前半段车阵中仅发生一次位置变化，林德布拉德全程跟在加布里埃尔·博托莱托身后。
这是赞德福特首次举办冲刺赛，也是本赛季六场冲刺赛中的第五场，该赛道未来没有举办大奖赛的合同。
马克斯·维斯塔潘也表示自己整场比赛被困在奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里身后，一旦接近轮胎就会过热而无法超车。
keyPointsEn: Only one position change occurred in the top half of the field after the first lap, and Lindblad spent his entire race behind Gabriel Bortoleto.
This was Zandvoort's first sprint race, the fifth of six this year, and the track does not have a contract to hold another grand prix in the future.
Max Verstappen also said he spent his entire race stuck behind Oscar Piastri, as getting close caused his tyres to overheat and prevented passing.

items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛赢家与输家
items.summaryZh: F1在赞德沃特举行的首次也是最后一次冲刺赛过程沉闷，但仍产生了赢家与输家。文章认为这提醒F1在2027年选择哪些分站采用冲刺赛形式时必须谨慎。
items.originalTitle: F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛赢家与输家
items.summaryEn: Formula 1's first and last sprint race at Zandvoort was far from a classic, but it still produced winners and losers. The author argues it serves as a warning that F1 must be careful when choosing which races get the sprint format in 2027.
detailZh: F1历史上第一次（也是最后一次）在荷兰大奖赛举办的冲刺赛很难称得上经典，但它确实产生了一些赢家和输家。
2027年我们将会有更多冲刺赛，虽然仅凭这场在赞德沃特举行的乏味比赛来评判这一决定并不公平，但这至少是一个警告：F1在选择哪些分站获得冲刺赛待遇时必须非常谨慎。
在这种所谓的“比赛”里，我见过超跑巡游都比这更有动作。在前列，勒克莱尔从内侧切入超越兰多·诺里斯，是唯一一次不借助发车完成的超车——而在发车时，基米·安东内利超过了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。弗兰科·科拉平托也在发车时抢占了角田裕毅的位次，来到第12位。
尼克·霍肯伯格退役的奥迪车和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯的病恹恹的凯迪拉克，甚至也在下游帮助了一些车手提升了名次。
一场糟糕透顶的比赛，我只希望排位赛和正赛能更好一些，好让赞德沃特在离开赛历时得到一场更配得上它的F1告别赛。因为就这场冲刺赛来看，我很高兴它要走了，而这实在不公平，也很令人难过。—— Jack Benyon
感谢老天，夏尔·勒克莱尔大胆决定在赞德沃特冲刺赛上使用软胎，而且居然敢……完成一次超车！太令人震惊了。
这是比赛后半段对诺里斯的一次漂亮的操作，不过勒克莱尔认为这次超车之所以能成功，是因为他看出诺里斯在直道上的能量输出没有他那么多。也许能量输出的策略和执行方式将成为贯穿整个周末的主题。
使用软胎本应带来起步阶段的优势和末段轮胎衰退时的劣势，但勒克莱尔的情况看起来恰恰相反，他觉得自己和车队在软胎上做的“功课”得到了印证。
最终，他的起步不佳，影响了前段的推进，但Leclerc和他的法拉利赛车让软胎的保持状态比一些使用中性胎的车手更久、更好，这对于正赛日来说是一个耐人寻味的前景。——JB
诺里斯的后轮在这场冲刺赛刚过三分之一的时候似乎突然急剧衰减，而皮亚斯特里在第五位上完全隐身，这表明迈凯伦今天的速度并不够快。
两位车手分别都是这场比赛中仅有的两次有意义的超车的受害者。
希望他们从中吸取了教训，并能应用到正赛中，因为如果中性胎衰减得这么快的情况持续下去，周日对他们来说可能会很艰难。——JB
无论乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）在夏天做了什么（也许是他的订婚），他从夏休期归来时焕然一新，并且完全具备了所需的心态，去抓住那些能让他保住争冠希望的成绩。
他在赞德沃特冲刺赛夺得的杆位和胜利（这是他今年五站中第三次包揽杆位和胜利），得益于排位赛中的完美执行以及比赛中一些聪明的轮胎管理——这表明他重新与W17赛车人车合一了。
他与基米·安东内利（安东内利）的积分差距仍然很大（56分），他也需要一些运气的眷顾，但拉塞尔已经证明，自己远未从不尽如人意的赛季上半程中出局。 - 乔恩·诺布尔
这个排名并不能很好地反映利亚姆·劳森（劳森）在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛中的表现，因为在阿维德·林德布拉德（Arvid Lindblad）在首圈抵挡住他的进攻后，他已无能为力。
此后，对Lawson来说这是一场令人沮丧的比赛，他始终无法对他平时的队友造成任何影响。
归根结底，Lawson的失利源于周五未能进入SQ3，而在大奖赛排位赛中闯入前十将是他确保自己不会在周日再次陷入困境的关键目标——到目前为止，这次替补出场的周末已经算是'相当体面'了。但要让它升级为'精彩'级别，他还需要做得更多。 - Josh Suttill
与发车网格上的大多数车手一样，这个成绩源于排位赛：搭载升级件的阿尔派车手Gasly在排位中领先中游集团，并在比赛中保持了这一位置。
鉴于超车机会寥寥，你不必对这场比赛做过多的解读。但尽管早早承受压力，Gasly还是能够将领先博托莱托的差距拉大到接近两秒。
对于一支在小红牛的升级把它挤到队内排序之前、一直感觉无所适从的车队来说，这是积极的信号。——JB
由于“从一开始就出现动力问题”，冲刺赛只跑完了七圈，霍肯伯格是里程方面最大的输家。
从第14位发车，他本来就不太可能拿分，但他确实需要跑圈来理解周五那场令人费解的SQ2出局——他自己几乎没有答案可以解释。——JS
detailEn: Formula 1's first (and last) ever sprint race at the Dutch Grand Prix was hardly a classic, but it did produce some winners and losers.

We’re going to have more sprint races in 2027, and while it wouldn’t be fair to judge that decision based purely on this turgid Zandvoort race, it’s at least a warning that F1 has to be very careful in choosing which races get the sprint treatment.

I’ve seen more action in supercar parades than this so-called 'race'. Up front, Leclerc’s dive down the inside of Lando Norris was the only overtake not assisted by the start, in which Kimi Antonelli jumped Oscar Piastri. Franco Colapinto also mugged Yuki Tsunoda at the start for 12th.
The retiring Audi of Nico Hulkenberg and Sergio Perez’s ailing Cadillac even assisted some of the rises up the order further down, too.

An awful race and I only hope qualifying and the race is better to give Zandvoort a more fitting F1 send-off as it leaves the calendar. Because based on that sprint, I’m happy it’s leaving, and that’s really not fair and very sad. - Jack Benyon
Thank goodness for Charles Leclerc’s gamble to wear soft tyres for the Zandvoort sprint, and to have the audacity to…make an overtake! Shocking.

It was a strong move on Norris in the second half of the race, although Leclerc reckoned it was boosted because he could see Norris didn’t have as much deployment on the straight as he did. Perhaps that will be a theme that runs through this weekend in terms of deployment styles and execution.

Using the soft tyres should have produced a gain at the start and a loss as they degraded at the end, but it looked the opposite for Leclerc, and he felt he and the team were vindicated by the “homework” they did on the softs.

Ultimately, he had a bad start which hampered early progress, but Leclerc and the Ferrari kept the softs in better condition for longer than some of the medium runners, which is an intriguing prospect for race day. - JB

Lando Norris’s rear tyres appeared to fall off a cliff just over a third of the way into this sprint race, and Oscar Piastri’s total anonymity in fifth just showed McLaren didn’t quite have the pace today.
Both drivers were victims of the only two meaningful overtakes of the race, respectively.
Hopefully they have learned a lesson from this that they can apply to the race as struggling that quickly on the mediums might make Sunday difficult for them if that continues. - JB

Whatever George Russell did over the summer (and maybe it was his engagement), he has returned from the summer break refreshed and with exactly the mental approach needed to grab the results that keep his title hopes alive.

His Zandvoort sprint pole and victory (the third time out of five he has done the double this year) were helped by perfect execution in qualifying and some clever tyre management in the race – showing he is back at one with the W17.

The points deficit to Kimi Antonelli is still big (56), and he is going to need a bit of luck on his side, but Russell has shown he is far down and out from a first half to the campaign that did not go to plan. - Jon Noble
This placement isn't much of a reflection of Liam Lawson's driving in the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race, as he couldn't do much once Arvid Lindblad fended off his attack on the opening lap.
Thereafter, it was a frustrating race for Lawson, who couldn't make any impression on his usual team-mate.

Ultimately, Lawson was doomed by not making it into SQ3 on Friday and breaking into the top 10 will be the key goal for grand prix qualifying to ensure he doesn't get stuck again on Sunday of what's been a 'very respectable' stand-in weekend so far. But he'll need to do more than this to tip it into 'spectacular' territory. - Josh Suttill
As with most drivers on the grid, this result was born out of qualifying, where the upgraded Alpine of Gasly led the midfield, and maintained that during the race.
Given the lack of overtaking, you wouldn’t want to read too much into this race. But despite early pressure, Gasly was able to gap Gabriel Bortoleto to the tune of nearly two seconds by the end.
Positive signs for a team which has felt in no-man’s-land while Racing Bulls’ upgrades had shoved it ahead in the pecking order. - JB
With just seven laps completed in the sprint thanks to a "power issue right from the beginning", Nico Hulkenberg is the biggest loser in mileage terms.
He was always unlikely to score points from 14th on the grid, but he did need laps to understand his baffling SQ2 exit on Friday, which he had very few answers to explain. - JS

items.summaryZh: 前F1车手乔利恩·帕尔默警告乔治·拉塞尔，必须抓住2026年的冠军争夺机会，否则可能永远不会再有更好的夺冠时机。

items.originalTitle: 帕尔默警告拉塞尔：2026年或是最佳夺冠机会
items.summaryEn: Former Formula 1 driver Jolyon Palmer has warned George Russell that he must capitalise on his 2026 championship fight, as it might be his best-ever shot at the title. F1 resumes this weekend at Zandvoort with the Dutch Grand Prix, which features the sprint format.
detailZh: Jolyon Palmer就F1总冠军向拉塞尔发出警告：'这可能是他有史以来最好的机会'
Jolyon Palmer认为，拉塞尔必须抓住他2026年的夺冠机会，这位梅赛德斯车手正力争缩小与总冠军领跑者安东内利之间的差距
据前F1车手Jolyon Palmer所说，拉塞尔必须充分利用他2026年的冠军争夺战，他警告这位梅赛德斯车手可能再也不会有更好的夺冠机会。
F1本周末将在赞德沃特重启，迎来采用冲刺赛赛制的荷兰大奖赛。随着夏休期后围场重新集结，Russell落后于他的梅赛德斯队友、总冠军领跑者安东内利 59分。七届总冠军汉密尔顿在积分榜上位居这两位梅赛德斯车手之间。
拉塞尔在2026赛季的开局相当艰难。虽然他赢得了揭幕战澳大利亚大奖赛和中国站冲刺赛，但他遭遇了一连串的霉运，而他的队友则连续五场大奖赛夺冠。赛季上半程，拉塞尔拿下两场大奖赛胜利，而安东内利则拿下了六场。
“自墨尔本以来，他过得并不轻松，他需要重新调整，”帕尔默在F1 TV的Weekend Warm-Up节目中解释道。
“所以，这正是完美的时机。你有几周的强制休赛期。去别的地方度过，而且心里还有一件大事，”他补充道，指的是拉塞尔向交往多年的伴侣卡门·蒙特罗·蒙德求婚一事。
“而且他确实需要做出回应。压力不仅在于争夺冠军的基米，也在于同样争夺冠军的乔治。这是他有史以来最好的机会。这可能仍将是他在F1中改变局面的最好机会。所以现在是时候抛弃各种借口，把成绩写在纸面上了。”
拉塞尔为荷兰大奖赛周末开了一个好头。在为冲刺赛夺得杆位后，他成功防住了迈凯伦的诺里斯和法拉利的勒克莱尔，拿下胜利，这是他本赛季的第三个冲刺赛冠军。
detailEn: Jolyon Palmer warns George Russell over F1 title: 'Might be his best-ever shot'
Jolyon Palmer believes George Russell must capitalise on his 2026 title opportunity as the Mercedes driver looks to close the gap to championship leader Kimi Antonelli
George Russell must capitalise on his 2026 championship fight, according to former Formula 1 driver Jolyon Palmer, who warns the Mercedes driver may never get a better title opportunity.

F1 resumes this weekend at Zandvoort for the Dutch Grand Prix, which features the sprint format. As the paddock reconvenes following the summer break, Russell trails his Mercedes team-mate and championship leader Kimi Antonelli by 59 points. Seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton splits the two Mercedes drivers in the standings.

Russell has endured a difficult start to his 2026 campaign. While he won the season-opening Australian Grand Prix and the Chinese sprint race, he suffered a string of bad luck while his team-mate claimed five consecutive grand prix wins. In the first half of the season, Russell secured two grand prix wins, whereas Antonelli took six.
"It's not been easy for him since Melbourne, and he needs to reset," Palmer explained during the F1 TV Weekend Warm-Up show.

"So, it's the perfect thing. You have a few weeks of enforced shutdown. Go and spend it away, something big on your mind as well," he added, referring to Russell's proposal to his long-term partner Carmen Montero Mundt.

"And he does need a response. The pressure is not only on Kimi with the title; it's on George with the title as well. This is his best-ever shot. It might stay as his best-ever shot in Formula 1 to make the difference here. So now is the time that the excuses have got to go and you've got to put it on the paper."

Russell has kicked off the Dutch Grand Prix weekend on a positive note. After securing pole position for the sprint race, he successfully defended against McLaren's Lando Norris and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc to take victory, his third sprint win of the season.

items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在赞德福特赛道领跑每一圈，轻松赢得冲刺赛冠军。比赛最后一圈突降暴雨，但拉塞尔已稳操胜券。

items.originalTitle: 拉塞尔轻松赢得冲刺赛冠军，最后一圈暴雨突袭 | 2026荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛报告
items.summaryEn: George Russell led every lap at Zandvoort to claim a straightforward sprint race victory. A downpour hit the track on the final lap, but Russell had already secured the win.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在赞德福特赛道的冲刺赛中领跑每一圈，轻松夺冠。
但比赛差点截然不同。当拉塞尔领跑车阵冲向终点旗时，暴雨突袭赛道，后方车手在冲向终点时必须小心应对。
拉塞尔的胜利使他在冠军争夺中将与队友安德烈亚·基米·安东内利的差距缩小了3分，另一位梅赛德斯车手仅获得第四名。安东内利在比赛起步时超越了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
在24圈的大部分时间里，前十名的位置没有其他变化。最终在第18圈，夏尔·勒克莱尔使用超车模式超越兰多·诺里斯升至第二。勒克莱尔选择使用软胎，而几乎所有其他车手都使用中性胎。
其余积分区车手从始至终保持相同位置。皮亚斯特里获得第五，领先马克斯·维斯塔潘，随后是刘易斯·汉密尔顿和皮埃尔·加斯利，尽管阿尔派车手在终点旗落下时落后超过25秒。
加布里埃尔·博尔托莱托以落后加斯利不到两秒的成绩冲过终点旗，阿尔维德·林德布拉德紧随其后。利亚姆·劳森在重返红牛的首场比赛中又落后两秒半完赛。
尼科·霍肯伯格是比赛中唯一退赛的车手，车队称原因是“动力问题”。塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在起步前驶入维修区，但随后加入了比赛。
维斯塔潘、汉密尔顿、角田裕毅、瓦尔特利·博塔斯和兰斯·斯特罗尔在冲刺赛后因在驶向发车格时未遵守赛事总监指示、在一号安全车线前停车而接受调查。所有人均被免于处罚，赛会干事裁定发车格非常拥挤，“车手行为得当，在尽可能靠近发车格的安全位置停车”。
博尔托莱托因赛前在维修区不安全释放仍在接受调查。
detailEn: George Russell led every lap of the sprint race at Zandvoort to claim a straightforward victory.
But it was nearly very different. A downpour hit the track as Russell led the field to the chequered flag and those further behind had to take care as they raced to the finish.

Russell’s win moves him three points closer to team mate Andrea Kimi Antonelli in the championship fight as the other Mercedes driver could only manage fourth place. Antonelli passed Oscar Piastri at the start of the race.

That remained the only change of position in the top 10 for most of the 24 laps. Eventually, on lap 18, Charles Leclerc used his Overtake Mode to move past Lando Norris into second place. Leclerc opted to run the race on the soft tyre compound while almost all of the other drivers used mediums.

The remaining points scorers occupied the same positions from start to finish. Piastri took fifth ahead of Max Verstappen, followed by Lewis Hamilton and Pierre Gasly, though the Alpine driver was over 25 seconds in arrears when the chequered flag fell.

Gabriel Bortoleto took the chequered flag just under two seconds behind Gasly, with Arvid Lindblad breathing down his neck. Liam Lawson finished another two-and-a-half seconds back in his first race back at Red Bull.
Nico Hulkenberg was the race’s only retirement due to what the team called a “power issue”. Sergio Perez peeled into the pit lane before the start but later joined in.

Verstappen, Hamilton, Yuki Tsunoda, Valtteri Bottas and Lance Stroll were investigated after the sprint race for failing to follow the race director’s instructions when driving to the grid by stopping before Safety Car Line One. All were cleared as the stewards ruled the grid was very crowded and “the driver acted appropriately and stopped the car in a safe spot as close as possible to the grid.”
Bortoleto remains under investigation for an unsafe release from the pits before the race.

勒克莱尔在第18圈使用超车模式超越诺里斯升至第二，他是唯一使用软胎的车手。

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔夺得荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛冠军
items.summaryZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在赞德沃特冲刺赛中从杆位发车夺冠，比赛过程平淡，前十名中仅有两次位置变化。
items.originalTitle: 拉塞尔赢得荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛
items.summaryEn: George Russell won the Zandvoort sprint race from pole in an uneventful contest, with only two position changes in the top 10 over 24 laps.
detailZh: 2026年F1赞德沃特冲刺赛与其说是一场真正的比赛，不如说会被误认为是一场汽车巡游，乔治·拉塞尔从杆位发车并夺冠，整场24圈中前十名之内仅发生了两次位置变化。
兰多·诺里斯在比赛的前一段努力给拉塞尔施压，但在第九和第十圈，由于车尾滑动不定，他落后拉塞尔超过一秒。这让拉塞尔获得了他所需要的喘息空间。
唯一的不确定性是比赛后期的降雨，它在拉塞尔冲线后几乎立刻降临。这为他扭转本赛季艰难开局的努力开了一个完美的头。
发车时前十名内唯一的位置变化是基米·安东内利超越了奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦，并开始追赶查尔斯·勒克莱尔，争夺领奖台上的最后一个位置。
仿佛是预料到这场比赛会枯燥乏味、要帮车迷一个忙，Leclerc 通过换上软胎增添了一丝看点——全场只有他和第17位发车的 Ollie Bearman 使用软胎——理论上这让他在轮胎后期衰退之前有机会在早段抢回一些位置。
但当比赛进行到三分之一时，前方车尾松滑的 Norris 陷入挣扎，Leclerc 得以对他施压，并在第18圈在1号弯切入内侧，将 Norris 挤出弯道并成功超越——这是整场比赛中除起步之外唯一一次有实质意义的超车。
Leclerc 未能追上 Russell，但他的软胎在最后阶段没有急剧衰退，最终锁定第二名。
Leclerc 完成超越后，Norris 立即遭到 Antonelli 的施压，Antonelli 一直追到最后一圈，在1号弯尝试了半个动作的俯冲超车，但未能成功，只能接受第四名。
皮亚斯特里位列第五，但差距非常大，被安东内利甩开；与此同时，马克斯·维斯塔潘和刘易斯·汉密尔顿之间上演了一场引人入胜的较量——这已成为2026年F1赛场上的常事。
汉密尔顿在比赛中期一度落后达两秒，尽管开局时咬得很紧，但在比赛尾声阶段他重新追了上来；正如这场比赛的典型情形，他始终无法完成一次能够保持住的超车。
皮埃尔·加斯利在整个比赛中一直承受压力，但他升级后的阿尔派赛车为他拿下最后一个积分，以第八名完赛，排在加布里埃尔·博托莱托的奥迪之前。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德再下一城，这位小红牛车手击败了他平时的队友利亚姆·劳森——劳森本周末在红牛车队顶替伊萨克·哈贾尔出战。
但在你指责 Lawson 之前，请记住这场比赛中超车的难度。
角田裕毅在起步时被 科拉平托 超越，也许这可以归因于角田首次使用 2026 年赛车所需的复杂流程进行比赛起步。
因此，没有配备 阿尔派 升级件的 Colapinto 以第 12 名完赛，排在了角田的前面。
detailEn: Formula 1's 2026 Zandvoort sprint race could have been mistaken for a car parade rather than an actual race, as George Russell won from pole and only two changes of position happened in the top 10 over the 24 laps.

Lando Norris managed to keep Russell under pressure for the first stretch of the race but over laps nine and 10 he lost over a second to Russell with a tail-happy rear-end. That allowed Russell the breathing room he needed.
The only uncertainty was late rain, which hit almost immediately after Russell crossed the line. The perfect start for his bid to turn around his tough first part of the season.
The change of position in the top 10 at the start came when Kimi Antonelli jumped Oscar Piastri’s McLaren and set about chasing Charles Leclerc for the last spot on the podium.

As if doing the fans a favour by anticipating the turgid race, Leclerc added a grain of interest by bolting on soft tyres - alongside only 17th-place starter Ollie Bearman - which theoretically gave him a chance at making up early positions before degrading later on.

But with Norris ahead struggling a third of the way through with a loose rear, Leclerc was able to pressure him and on lap 18 he dived to the inside at Turn 1, pushing Norris wide and barging through for the only meaningful overtake of the race not happening at the start.
Leclerc wasn't able to catch Russell but avoided his softs going off dramatically at the end to seal second.

Norris immediately came under pressure from Antonelli once Leclerc went through, and Antonelli tried all the way up until the last lap when he half-tried a Turn 1 dive, but couldn’t make it stick and had to settle for fourth.
Piastri was a very distant fifth, dropped by Antonelli, while an intriguing battle between Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton - a regular occurrence in 2026 F1.
Hamilton dropped as far as two seconds behind at mid-race, having been close early on, but Hamilton closed back in during the closing stages, typically of this race, unable to make a move stick.
Pierre Gasly was under pressure for the entire race, but his upgraded Alpine yielded the final point for eighth ahead of Gabriel Bortoleto’s Audi.
Arvid Lindblad claimed another scalp as the Racing Bulls driver beat his usual team-mate Liam Lawson, who’s standing in for Isack Hadjar this weekend at Red Bull.
But before you condemn Lawson, remember the difficulty in overtaking in this race.
Yuki Tsunoda lost out to Franco Colapinto at the start, perhaps that could be put down to Tsunoda doing his first-ever race start with the complicated process required for 2026 cars.
So Colapinto - without the Alpine upgrade - took 12th ahead of Tsunoda.

items.summaryEn: George Russell won the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race from pole, leading all the way for his third Saturday victory of the 2026 Formula 1 season. Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and McLaren's Lando Norris finished second and third.
detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：拉塞尔掌控冲刺赛，勒克莱尔超越诺里斯获第二
乔治·拉塞尔在赞德福特从杆位赢得周六F1冲刺赛，而他的领跑车手积分榜的队友安东内利仅获得第四。
乔治·拉塞尔从杆位统治了荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛，赢得他2026年F1赛季的第三个周六胜利。
这位梅赛德斯车手从起步灯灭起一路领先，比赛过程相当平淡，法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔和迈凯伦的兰多·诺里斯在干燥的赞德福特赛道上登上领奖台。
此前拉塞尔在周五取得杆位，受益于队友基米·安东内利的底板损坏，后者在SQ1倒数第二个弯道失误，损失了“25个点”的下压力。
这让这位积分榜领跑者在发车格上位列第五，排在拉塞尔和诺里斯组成的前排之后，勒克莱尔和诺里斯的队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里分别排在第三和第四。
起步灯灭时，拉塞尔顺利起步，挡住了诺里斯，但安东内利立即在1号弯外侧超越皮亚斯特里，上升了一个位置。
这位19岁车手立即对勒克莱尔施加压力，后者使用软胎起步，而其他车手使用中性胎，但正如预期，超车被证明很困难。
因此在这条狭窄的海滨赛道上，开局几圈相当静止，但实力相当的车手们在保护轮胎的同时仍然彼此紧咬。
然而从第10圈开始，一切开始升温，梅赛德斯允许拉塞尔更用力推进，领先者迅速拉开与此时已显脆弱的诺里斯两秒的差距。
“我的车尾没有抓地力，”这位卫冕世界冠军报告说，他无法将目光从后视镜中的法拉利和梅赛德斯上移开，来自后方的压力从未减弱。
结果勒克莱尔终于在第18圈1号弯内线超越诺里斯，虽然法拉利迅速拉开，但迈凯伦仍必须防守安东内利。
但在赞德福特，跟在前车一秒之内是一回事，超车又是另一回事，诺里斯真正需要做的只是保持在白线之内。
他做到了，这位26岁车手成功守住第三，落后冠军拉塞尔，后者以1.4秒优势领先勒克莱尔冲线，法拉利车手取得他2026年的第三个冲刺赛领奖台。
安东内利获得第四，落后诺里斯0.4秒，落后第五名的皮亚斯特里4.6秒，红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘在主场观众面前以0.3秒之差位列第六。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿驾驶另一辆法拉利从未参与竞争，获得第七，阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利以第八名拿下最后一个积分位置。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Russell controls sprint race as Leclerc overhauls Norris for second
George Russell won the Saturday F1 sprint race at Zandvoort from pole, while his championship-leading team-mate Antonelli could only muster fourth
George Russell dominated the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race from pole for his third Saturday victory of the 2026 Formula 1 campaign.
The Mercedes driver led all the way from lights out in a rather processional affair, with Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc and McLaren’s Lando Norris completing the podium at a dry Zandvoort.
It came after Russell grabbed pole on Friday after profiting from floor damage for his team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who lost “25 points” of downforce due to an off at the penultimate corner in SQ1.
That left the championship leader fifth on the grid behind a front row of Russell and Norris, with Leclerc and Norris’ team-mate Oscar Piastri respectively lining up third and fourth.
At lights out Russell enjoyed a solid getaway by holding Norris at bay, but Antonelli immediately gained a place with a sweeping move around the outside of Piastri at Turn 1.
The 19-year-old applied instant pressure on Leclerc, who started on soft tyres compared to the rest on medium rubber, but as expected overtaking proved difficult.
So the opening laps were rather static around the tight seaside circuit, but the evenly-matched drivers still remained within touching distance of each other as they preserved their tyres.
Everything started to ramp up though come lap 10 when Mercedes allowed Russell to push harder and the leader quickly streaked clear of a now vulnerable Norris by two seconds.
“I’ve got no rear,” reported the reigning world champion, who couldn’t keep his eyes off the Ferrari and Mercedes in his mirrors and that pressure from behind never died.
It resulted in Leclerc finally making his overtake down the inside of Norris at Turn 1 on lap 18 and while the Ferrari quickly pulled ahead, the McLaren still had to defend from Antonelli.
But once again at Zandvoort, staying within a second of the car in front is one thing, yet overtaking is another and all Norris really needed to do was keep it within the white lines.
That he did so the 26-year-old managed to hold on to third behind winner Russell, who crossed the line 1.4 seconds ahead of Leclerc, the Ferrari driver taking his third sprint podium of 2026.
Antonelli took fourth, 0.4s off Norris, with an extra 4.6s to fifth-placed Piastri who had Red Bull’s Max Verstappen just 0.3s behind in sixth in front of his home crowd.
Lewis Hamilton was never in contention aboard the sister Ferrari as he took seventh, with Alpine’s Pierre Gasly completing the points positions in eighth.
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯车手安东内利在SQ1倒数第二个弯道失误损失下压力，最终从第五位发车，以第四名完赛。
勒克莱尔使用软胎起步，在第18圈1号弯内线超越诺里斯升至第二。
维斯塔潘主场作战获得第六，汉密尔顿第七，加斯利第八拿下最后一分。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes driver Antonelli lost downforce after an off at the penultimate corner in SQ1, started fifth and finished fourth.
Leclerc, who started on soft tyres, overtook Norris on the inside at Turn 1 on lap 18 to take second.
Verstappen finished sixth in front of his home crowd, Hamilton was seventh and Gasly took the final point in eighth.

拉塞尔从杆位开始统治了荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛，这是他2026年F1赛季的第三个周六胜利。

“我的车后部没有抓地力了，”这位卫冕世界冠军报告说，他无法将目光从后视镜中的法拉利和梅赛德斯上移开，而后方传来的压力从未消失。

The Mercedes driver led all the way from lights out in a rather processional affair with Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc and McLaren’s Lando Norris completing the podium at a dry Zandvoort.
It came after Russell grabbed pole on Friday after profiting from floor damage for his team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who lost “25 points” of downforce due to an off at the penultimate corner in SQ1.
That left the championship leader fifth on the grid behind a front row of Russell and Norris, with Leclerc and Norris’ team-mate Oscar Piastri respectively lining up third and fourth.
At lights out, Russell enjoyed a solid getaway by holding Norris at bay, but Antonelli immediately gained a place with a sweeping move around the outside of Piastri at Turn 1.
The 19-year-old applied instant pressure on Leclerc, who started on soft tyres compared to the rest on medium rubber, but as expected overtaking proved difficult.
The opening laps were rather static around the tight seaside circuit, but the evenly-matched drivers still remained within touching distance of each other as they preserved their tyres.
Lando Norris reported a lack of rear grip
Everything started to ramp up, though, come lap 10 when Mercedes allowed Russell to push harder and the leader quickly streaked clear of a now vulnerable Norris by two seconds.
“I’ve got no rear,” reported the reigning world champion, who couldn’t keep his eyes off the Ferrari and Mercedes in his mirrors and that pressure from behind never died.
It resulted in Leclerc finally making his overtake down the inside of Norris at Turn 1 on lap 18 and while the Ferrari quickly pulled ahead, the McLaren still had to defend from Antonelli.
But once again at Zandvoort, staying within a second of the car in front is one thing, yet overtaking is another, and all Norris really needed to do was keep it within the white lines.
That he did, so the 26-year-old managed to hold on to third behind winner Russell, who crossed the line 1.4 seconds ahead of Leclerc - the Ferrari driver taking his third sprint podium of 2026.
Antonelli took fourth, 0.4s off Norris, with an extra 4.6s to fifth-placed Piastri who had Red Bull’s Max Verstappen just 0.3s behind in sixth in front of his home crowd.
Lewis Hamilton was never in contention aboard the sister Ferrari as he took seventh, with Alpine’s Pierre Gasly completing the points positions in eighth.

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘续约红牛被视为对梅基斯领导力的“重要肯定”

items.summaryEn: F1 TV analyst Alex Brundle has hailed Max Verstappen's long-term commitment to Red Bull as a strong endorsement of Laurent Mekies' leadership.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘对红牛的长期承诺被誉为对洛朗·梅基斯的“重要肯定”
亚历克斯·布伦德尔认为，马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛签订的新长期合同是对洛朗·梅基斯的一次重大信任投票
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，洛朗·梅基斯，红牛车队领队
F1电视分析员亚历克斯·布伦德尔盛赞马克斯·维斯塔潘对红牛的长期承诺，称这是对洛朗·梅基斯领导能力的有力背书。
在经历了数月关于他在一级方程式（Formula 1）未来的猜测之后，这位四届冠军签下了一份新合同，从而终结了围场里的种种传闻，新合同将让他留在这家位于米尔顿凯恩斯的车队直至2030年底。
红牛车队在过去艰难的两年里经历了接连不断的人事变动，其中包括2025年7月梅基斯接替长期任职的克里斯蒂安·霍纳，升任车队领队。
在赞德沃特接受F1电视台《周末热身》（Weekend Warm-Up）节目的采访时，布伦德尔表示，维斯塔潘的长期合同传递出了一个强烈的信号。
他说：“对于梅基斯领导下的红牛来说，这可以说是维斯塔潘给予的一个相当重要的认可，不是吗？考虑到红牛过去发生的一切，过去几年里出现了一定程度的人才流失，人员不断流失等等，对洛朗·梅基斯和车队来说，情况不可能再好了。”
维斯塔潘本人在周四的新闻发布会上也表达了同样的看法，他热情地谈到了工作环境以及领导层的透明度。
"是啊，其实压力并不算太大，"这位荷兰车手对媒体说道。"这是一个正确的决定。我在车队里感觉非常好。我们坚信未来几年能够重返巅峰。
"对我来说，这里就像一个大家庭，所以我很高兴能成为其中的一员。在过去几个月里，大家一直在谈论车队未来几年的发展、计划和想法。这些信息始终以非常开放的方式传达给我，这正是我所喜欢的。
"我喜欢他们想要实现的目标，这也是我为什么希望在将来继续成为其中一员的原因。"
detailEn: Max Verstappen's Red Bull commitment hailed as "important vindication" of Laurent Mekies
Alex Brundle believes Max Verstappen’s new long-term Red Bull deal is a major vote of confidence in Laurent Mekies
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Laurent Mekies, Red Bull Racing Team Principal
F1 TV analyst Alex Brundle has hailed Max Verstappen's long-term commitment to Red Bull as a strong endorsement of Laurent Mekies' leadership.

Following months of speculation regarding his future in Formula 1, the four-time champion put an end to the paddock rumours by signing a new contract that keeps him at the Milton Keynes outfit until the end of 2030.

Red Bull has endured a challenging couple of years with a string of personnel changes, including Mekies stepping up to take the team principal position from the long-standing Christian Horner in July 2025.
Speaking on F1 TV's Weekend Warm-Up broadcast at Zandvoort, Brundle argued that Verstappen's long-term contract sends a strong message.

"It's a pretty important vindication, isn't it, of Red Bull under Mekies from Max Verstappen," he said. "With everything that's been going on at Red Bull, a bit of a brain drain over the last couple of years, losing personnel and all of the rest, it couldn't have gone much better for Laurent Mekies and the team."
Verstappen himself echoed those sentiments during Thursday's press conference, speaking warmly about the working environment and the transparency of the leadership.

"Yeah, I mean it wasn't really too stressful," the Dutchman told the media. "It was the right call. I feel really good within the team. We have a lot of belief that we can get back to the top in the coming years.

"For me, this feels like one big family, so I'm just very happy to be a part of that. And over the last few months, you talk about the team moving forward in the coming years, plans, ideas. So it's always been communicated to me in a very open way, and that's what I like.
"I like what they're trying to achieve, and that's why I also want to be part of it in the future."
keyPointsZh: 布伦德尔认为维斯塔潘续约对梅基斯是重要的信心背书。
keyPointsEn: Brundle believes Verstappen's renewal is a significant vote of confidence in Mekies.

detailZh: 京特·施泰纳敦促凯迪拉克放弃2026年一级方程式赛车的研发
京特·施泰纳敦促凯迪拉克放弃继续研发其表现挣扎的2026年一级方程式赛车，并将资源集中于2027年。
前哈斯车队领队京特·施泰纳认为，凯迪拉克应该立即停止对其首辆2026年一级方程式赛车的研发，并将资源转向2027年的赛车。
凯迪拉克于2026年初加入锦标赛，车手阵容是经验丰富的塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯和瓦尔特里·博塔斯。
虽然车队在这个阶段未必指望能拿到积分，但还是遇到了可靠性问题。目前车队在车队积分榜上排名第11，积分为零。
在这支美国车队宣布格拉姆·洛登被马尔钦·布德科夫斯基取代领队职务后，施泰纳解释说，他预计车队的下一个消息就是将重心转向2027年。
“之前外界有很高的期望。如果他们排在最后，那也罢了，但他们落后太多了，甚至没有机会排在倒数第二，”施泰纳在参加《红旗播客》（Red Flags Podcast）节目时解释道。
他补充道：“我们很快会看到一则公告，说本赛季已经放弃，让我们专注于2027年。再为2026年做任何事情都没有意义了。手头已有的东西就做完，然后把所有精力都放在2027年上。”
“我认为马尔钦一上任，那将是他要做的第一件事。他不会为阿布扎比的比起新造一个前翼了。他已经不在乎这件事了，因为那趟火车已经开走，或者说那艘船已经启航了。”
施泰纳认为，凯迪拉克的管理层是带着过高的期望来到2026年发车区的。
“我觉得就是他们以为事情更容易，而且不相信任何人说的话，”这位前哈斯车队领队说。“他们当中很多人不是F1出身，他们只是想着：‘好吧，我们干就是了，为什么这些人都跟我们说这很难？反正我们比他们更懂。’
detailEn: Guenther Steiner urges Cadillac to abandon 2026 F1 car development
Guenther Steiner has urged Cadillac to abandon further development of its struggling 2026 Formula 1 car and focus its resources on 2027.
Former Haas team principal Guenther Steiner believes Cadillac should immediately abandon development on its maiden 2026 Formula 1 machinery and shift its resources towards the 2027 car.
Cadillac entered the championship at the start of 2026 with the experienced driver line-up of Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas.
While the team had not necessarily expected to be picking up points at this stage, it has encountered reliability issues. It currently sits 11th in the constructors' standings with no points.

After the American outfit announced that Graeme Lowdon had been replaced as team principal by Marcin Budkowski, Steiner explained that the next news he expects to get from the team is that it is now focusing on 2027.

"There were a lot of expectations created. If they had been last, fine, but they are so far off, they have no chance to be second-last," Steiner explained during an appearance on The Red Flags Podcast.

He added: "We will get an announcement that this season is over, let's focus on '27. There is no point doing anything for '26 anymore. Whatever you've got in the pipeline, do it, but then just focus on '27.

"I think that Marcin, when he gets in there, that's the first thing he will be doing. He will not try to make a new front wing for the race in Abu Dhabi. He doesn't care about it anymore because that train has gone or that ship has sailed."
Steiner argued that Cadillac's management arrived at the 2026 grid with inflated expectations.

"I think it's just like they thought it was easier and didn't believe anybody," the former Haas team principal said. "There are a lot of people who are not from F1, and they just think: 'OK, we do it, and why do all these people tell us it's difficult? We know better anyway.'"

items.titleZh: 拉塞尔夺赞德沃特冲刺杆位，但数据向梅赛德斯发出警示
items.summaryZh: 拉塞尔在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛中为梅赛德斯拿下杆位，但性能数据显示迈凯伦取得关键进步，表明梅赛德斯可能无法再推迟引进更多升级。
items.originalTitle: 梅赛德斯赞德沃特数据中的警示
items.summaryEn: George Russell's sprint pole at the Dutch Grand Prix offered Mercedes relief, but performance data showing McLaren's key progress suggests Mercedes may not be able to delay bringing further upgrades much longer.
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔在一级方程式荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛中拿下杆位，让梅赛德斯松了一口气，因为其按兵不动、暂缓升级的策略尚未让车队掉入中游集团。
法拉利和迈凯伦在为赛车引进研发套件方面一直很激进——双方最新的升级件都出现在赞德沃特——而梅赛德斯则在下一盘长棋。
自五月的加拿大大奖赛以来，它有选择地只进行了一次重大规格改动，并把研发经费留到赛季末再大笔投入，届时它希望竞争对手的钱袋已经掏空。
不过，尽管拉塞尔力压兰多·诺里斯的迈凯伦展现出W17依然非常强大，但数据深处却隐藏着一个明显的警告信号：梅赛德斯可能无法再等太久，必须尽快带来更多升级。
拉塞尔击败诺里斯夺得杆位的优势只有0.041秒，但两人做出单圈的过程非常跌宕起伏——各计时段之间差异巨大。
两人在中间计时段相差近半秒，基米·安东内利也同样落后，说明这是梅赛德斯车队的整体趋势。
在2026年一级方程式规则下，这种波动并不罕见，通常来自不同的能量部署策略——即一名车手在某条直道上比另一名车手使用更多能量。
诺里斯和拉塞尔之间的部分差距可以由此解释，例如在冲线结束单圈时，两车之间存在很大的速度差异。
当拉塞尔的梅赛德斯在冲向计时线时持续加速到317公里/小时（197英里/小时），诺里斯的迈凯伦则在达到约307公里/小时（191英里/小时）的峰值后速度开始回落。
但梅赛德斯在这里的优势似乎并不是它在其他路段刻意节省能量所带来的好处，因为两者之间最高速度的唯一真正区别，出现在迈凯伦似乎在本圈起步阶段使用了更多能量的地方。
事实上，深入分析他们SQ3最佳单圈的遥测数据可以发现，拉塞尔糟糕的中间计时段与在直道上节省能量毫无关系——问题出在过弯的表现上。
如上面的数据所示（数据来自F1tel.com），梅赛德斯在高速的7号弯和8号弯上一直不如迈凯伦和法拉利——无论是拉塞尔还是安东内利，都无法以接近迈凯伦和法拉利的速度通过这两个弯。
虽然迈凯伦的升级帮助诺里斯在7号弯以253公里/小时（157英里/小时）的最低速度通过，在8号弯达到219公里/小时（136英里/小时），而拉塞尔则分别降至242公里/小时（150英里/小时）和205公里/小时（127英里/小时）。
这些差距让诺里斯从当时落后拉塞尔0.2秒，重新追平了拉塞尔。
在这两个高速弯中的表现表明迈凯伦最近的升级取得了明显进步——因为这与我们今年早些时候在同级别速度区间的弯道中所看到的情况形成了对比。
例如在银石赛道，诺里斯在科普斯弯比拉塞尔慢7公里/小时（4.3英里/小时）（283公里/小时对276公里/小时），在斯托弯也落后了类似的差距（238公里/小时对231公里/小时）。
梅赛德斯现在需要弄清楚的是，赛车在赞德沃特7号/8号弯速度上的损失，究竟说明它真的在高速弯上落后了、需要通过一些赛车改进来做出回应，还是存在调校或驾驶方式上的问题导致它暴露了弱点。
当梅赛德斯在周六下午再次尝试排位赛时，这个问题会得到更清晰的答案。
detailEn: George Russell's sprint pole position at Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix provided relief for Mercedes that its strategy of holding fire on upgrades had not yet dropped it into the pack.
While Ferrari and McLaren have been aggressive in bringing development packages to their cars – with latest updates from both appearing at Zandvoort – Mercedes has been playing the long game.
Having selectively had just one major spec change at the Canadian GP in May, it is saving its development spending for an end of season splurge when it hopes the coffers of its rivals are empty.

But despite Russell's form in edging out Lando Norris's McLaren showing that the W17 is still very strong, tucked away in the data is a clear warning signal that Mercedes may not be able to wait much longer before needing to bring more.
Russell's advantage over Norris to take pole was a slim 0.041 seconds, but there was a very topsy turvy nature to how they achieved their laps – with big variability between sectors.
There was nearly half a second of difference between them in the middle sector, with Kimi Antonelli similarly adrift to show that this was a Mercedes trend.
Under F1's 2026 rules, such variability is not uncommon and often comes from different deployment strategies – where one driver will use more energy on one straight compared to another.
Some of the difference between Norris and Russell can be explained from this, with there being a big speed difference for example as they run to end the lap.
As Russell's Mercedes keeps accelerating to 317km/h (197mph) in the chase to the timing line, Norris's McLaren peaks at around 307km/h (191mph) before falling away.

But the Mercedes advantage here does not seem to be the upside to it having deliberately not used energy elsewhere, as the only real difference in top speeds between them is when McLaren appeared to have used more at the start of the lap.
In fact, digging into the telemetry of their best SQ3 efforts, the poor middle sector of Russell's was nothing to do with saving energy on the straights – it was performance through the corners.

As the data above shows, which we have used from F1tel.com shows, Mercedes has been struggling compared to McLaren and Ferrari in the high-speed Turns 7 and 8 – which neither Russell nor Kimi Antonelli can take anywhere near as fast as McLaren and Ferrari.
While McLaren's upgrade has helped Norris keep his minimum speed up at 253km/h (157mph) through Turn 7 and 219km/h (136mph) at Turn 8, Russell drops to 242km/h (150mph) and 205km/h (127mph).
Those differences pull Norris back from two tenths of a second adrift at the time, to back on par with Russell.

The performance through these two high-speed corners points to McLaren having made a clear step with its most recent upgrade – as it is in contrast to what we have seen in turns with such a speed range earlier in the year.
At Silverstone, for example, Norris was 7km/h (4.3mph) slower than Russell through Copse (283km/h vs 276km/h), and a similar speed adrift at Stowe (238km/h vs 231km/h).

What Mercedes now needs to understand is whether that speed offset through Turns 7/8 at Zandvoort is a sign that it has genuinely fallen back in high-speed corners so needs to respond with some car improvements, or if there is some set-up or driving approach issue that has left it exposed.
A clearer answer for that will come when Mercedes has another go at qualifying on Saturday afternoon.
